verdict.rationale: NotebookLM offers generated 'briefing documents' and other report types with sections/summaries (docs-27), auto-generated source summaries (docs-5), and export to Google Docs/Sheets or sharing via public link (docs-13, docs-8), which supports building and sharing structured reports. However, there's no explicit evidence of native table generation within these reports, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of report quality for stakeholder-ready outputs. Missing for 10: explicit table support within generated reports, independent validation of report structure/quality for stakeholder sharing.
